what: Windows batch file from Open-OSS/privacy-filter; the repository's README told users to run it (or python loader.py) to start the attack chain.

evidence.basis: HiddenLayer prints this SHA-256 for start.bat in the report's indicators of compromise, and its analysis says the README instructed users to run start.bat.

source.title: Malware Found in Trending Hugging Face Repository "Open-OSS/privacy-filter"
